description: Character lighting contexts. Directions are CAMERA-RELATIVE so a profile keeps its look from any camera angle: azimuth 0 = light comes from behind the camera, +90 = from screen right, 180 = from behind the subject (backlight). Elevation 0 = horizontal, +90 = straight down. The character light rig uses render layer 2 only; environment lighting is scaled, never replaced.

rig.key: DirectionalLight3D, shadows on, cull mask = character layer. The only light that drives the toon ramp's lit/shadow boundary.
rig.kicker: Optional SpotLight3D with a tight cone on the head for close-ups: high-resolution hair-on-face shadows that a directional shadow map cannot resolve at 85 mm.
rig.fill: Environment ambient light (color + energy). It lifts the shadow side and must never flatten it: fill_energy <= 0.45 * key_energy.
rig.rim: Shader rim (fresnel, masked toward rim azimuth) set as instance uniforms on character materials. Cheaper and more controllable than a physical back light.

lookdev_neutral.purpose: QC turnarounds. Honest, even, slightly flat. Hides nothing.

gameplay_readable.purpose: Matches. Clear value separation between character, court and ball. Shadows present but never hide the pose.

lobby_warm.purpose: Home screen / character menu. Warm gym window light, soft and flattering.

cinematic_soft.purpose: Close-up faces and hair. Soft key high on the face, crisp hair shadow, gentle rim for separation.

cinematic_dramatic.purpose: Tension beats and action shots. Strong side key, deep but tinted shadows, strong rim, dimmed arena.

sp_hero.purpose: S+ hero shots. The environment falls away, the character's accent color becomes the rim and the atmosphere. The face must stay fully readable.

sp_blackout.purpose: The negative beat before a reveal: near-black, only the rim draws the silhouette.

palette_tokens.note: Colors beginning with '@' are resolved from the character's palette (character.json: palette.accent, palette.accent_dark, palette.backdrop).
